subject.title: [Architecture] Enforce strict typings for command payloads in packages/gateway-protocol

question: Should method-specific Gateway payload typing remain an internal built-in-method map, or become a new extensible public plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The shared handler type is consumed by plugin registration, so the choice determines whether this is an internal refactor or a compatibility-sensitive public API redesign.

options.title: Type built-ins internally
options.body: Add a schema-derived typed map for core methods while retaining the existing generic plugin handler boundary.

options.title: Design an extensible method map
options.body: Create a public generic or declaration-extensible plugin method registry and migrate built-in and plugin handlers together.

options.title: Keep validation-only typing
options.body: Retain generic handler params and continue narrowing within each validated handler without adding a method map.

recommendation.title: Type built-ins internally
recommendation.body: Add a schema-derived typed map for core methods while retaining the existing generic plugin handler boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent App SDK and Gateway API history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the public-versus-internal contract decision.
